QQ login related data folder with two files; parent is user_data; contains no subdirs; files are unnamed which could be login tokens or session data; should remain as user_data.
QQ mini program data; has subdirectory 3.1.0.1; should descend to check contents of version folder; parent_labels is user_data so inherits user_data.

mmkv is a key-value database storage library used by apps; files like mmkv.default, nt_mmkv_* are persistent storage; has subdir specialCharacter; should descend to check; classification as db due to persistent structured storage nature.

msf (message service framework) contains files like msfnethistory which are persistent database records; security_data subdir likely contains encrypted security data; should descend; classification as db.

PokeFace contains subdirectories named 2000-2011 likely representing face sticker IDs; this is QQ's poke face feature which are emoji/sticker resources; should descend to check if actual image files exist inside.
Skin folder contains two hash-named files (likely md5 hashes) which suggest downloaded cached skin resources; parent is user_data but these are temporary cached resources; classification as cache.
UnitedConfig contains NTUnitedConfig files which are configuration databases; has subdir specialCharacter; should descend; classification as db for persistent configuration storage.
VasUpdateSystem contains subdir bubble; likely update/downloaded resources for QQ VAS (value-added services); should descend to check; classification as cache for downloaded update files.
CustomEmotion subfolder with four files; these are custom emoticon/sticker files stored without extensions; parent is user_data but CustomEmotion represents user-added media content; should be media.
CustomEmotion subfolder with two files; same as folder 00; these are custom emoticons in WeChat; should be media.
